cases.name: Kimberly Kellam
cases.narrative: On 6/13/2023, he led investigators to her remains along with her 11-year-old daughter's, covered up by blankets and clothing and located inside a garage at their abandoned Wise County, TX home. Morairity showed them a tarp outside the garage. Animals dragged a body that the affidavit suggests was the child out of the garage, so Morairity wrapped her in the tarp and placed a box, broken table and a bicycle on top, according to the affidavit. Morairity directed investigators to the center of the garage and a large plastic tub often used to water livestock in which there was a body, according to the affidavit.
